title: 搭乘大眾運輸
description: 搭乘公車、捷運、火車的常用對話

sentences.en: Excuse me, could you tell me which platform I should go to if I want to catch the express train that goes directly to the city center?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，請問如果我想搭直達市中心的快車，應該去哪個月台？

sentences.en: The subway line that connects the airport to downtown is currently undergoing maintenance, so passengers are advised to take the shuttle bus instead.
sentences.zh: 連接機場到市區的地鐵線目前正在維修中，因此建議乘客改搭接駁巴士。

sentences.en: According to the announcement, the next northbound train, which was originally scheduled for three fifteen, has been delayed by approximately twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 根據廣播，原定三點十五分的下一班北上列車已延誤約二十分鐘。

sentences.en: If you transfer at the next station, which is a major interchange hub, you can catch the line that takes you directly to the museum district.
sentences.zh: 如果你在下一站轉車——那是一個主要的轉運樞紐——你可以搭到直達博物館區的路線。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if you could tell me whether this bus, which seems to be heading east, stops anywhere near the central library.
sentences.zh: 如果你能告訴我這班看起來往東開的公車是否有停靠中央圖書館附近，我會很感激。

sentences.en: The monthly transit pass, which includes unlimited rides on buses and subways, costs significantly less than buying individual tickets every day.
sentences.zh: 月票包含公車和地鐵的無限次搭乘，費用比每天買單程票便宜許多。

sentences.en: Having missed the last train due to working overtime, I had no choice but to wait for the night bus that runs every forty-five minutes.
sentences.zh: 因為加班錯過了末班車，我只好等每四十五分鐘一班的夜間公車。

sentences.en: The new contactless payment system, which was recently introduced across the entire network, allows passengers to tap their phones instead of using physical cards.
sentences.zh: 最近在整個路網推出的新式感應支付系統，讓乘客可以用手機感應代替實體卡片。

sentences.en: Could you please let me know whether I need to validate my ticket before boarding, or if the conductor will check it during the journey?
sentences.zh: 能否請你告訴我上車前是否需要驗票，還是車掌會在途中查票？

sentences.en: The train that departs from platform seven, which is located at the far end of the station, makes fewer stops and arrives thirty minutes earlier.
sentences.zh: 從七號月台——位於車站最遠端——出發的列車停靠站較少，會早到三十分鐘。

sentences.en: Since the escalator leading to the underground platform is out of service, elderly passengers and those with heavy luggage should use the elevator on the left.
sentences.zh: 由於通往地下月台的手扶梯停止運作，年長乘客和攜帶大件行李者請使用左邊的電梯。

sentences.en: I noticed that the route map displayed above the doors shows this train splitting into two sections at the junction station ahead.
sentences.zh: 我注意到門上方的路線圖顯示這班列車會在前方的分岔站分成兩段。

sentences.en: The bus driver, who was extremely helpful and patient, explained that I should get off at the fifth stop and then walk two blocks north.
sentences.zh: 那位非常樂於助人又有耐心的公車司機解釋說我應該在第五站下車，然後往北走兩個街區。

sentences.en: Passengers traveling with bicycles are kindly reminded that folding bikes are permitted at all times, whereas regular bikes are only allowed during off-peak hours.
sentences.zh: 提醒攜帶腳踏車的乘客，折疊車全時段皆可攜帶，而一般腳踏車僅限離峰時段。

sentences.en: If the train is too crowded to board, which often happens during rush hour, you might want to wait for the next one arriving in three minutes.
sentences.zh: 如果列車太擠上不去——尖峰時段常發生這種情況——你可以等三分鐘後到站的下一班。

sentences.en: The information booth near the main entrance, staffed by multilingual attendants, can provide you with detailed timetables and fare information.
sentences.zh: 主入口附近的服務台配有多語言服務人員，可以提供你詳細的時刻表和票價資訊。

sentences.en: Having realized that I accidentally boarded the wrong train heading in the opposite direction, I quickly got off at the next stop to switch platforms.
sentences.zh: 發現自己不小心搭上反方向的列車後，我趕緊在下一站下車換月台。

sentences.en: The commuter rail service, which connects the suburban residential areas to the business district, operates every fifteen minutes during peak hours.
sentences.zh: 連接郊區住宅區到商業區的通勤鐵路，在尖峰時段每十五分鐘一班。

sentences.en: Would you mind moving slightly to the left so that the passengers who need to exit at this stop can get through the doors more easily?
sentences.zh: 你介意稍微往左邊移動一下嗎？好讓需要在這站下車的乘客更容易通過車門。

sentences.en: The transit authority has announced that starting next month, all buses equipped with wheelchair ramps will display a blue accessibility symbol on the front.
sentences.zh: 交通局宣布從下個月起，所有配備輪椅坡道的公車都會在車頭顯示藍色無障礙標誌。

sentences.en: I was told by the station attendant that the special weekend pass, which is valid for unlimited travel, can be purchased from any automated machine.
sentences.zh: 站務人員告訴我，可在任何自動售票機購買週末特惠票，該票可無限次搭乘。

sentences.en: Because of the severe weather warning issued earlier this morning, several train services running along the coastal route have been suspended until further notice.
sentences.zh: 由於今早稍早發布的嚴重天氣警報，沿海岸路線行駛的數班列車已暫停服務直到另行通知。

sentences.en: The priority seats located near the doors are reserved for pregnant women, elderly passengers, and those with disabilities, so please offer your seat if needed.
sentences.zh: 靠近車門的博愛座保留給孕婦、年長乘客及身障人士，因此需要時請讓座。

sentences.en: Not only does the new express service reduce travel time by half, but it also offers free Wi-Fi and charging ports at every seat.
sentences.zh: 新的快捷服務不僅將行車時間縮短一半，還在每個座位提供免費Wi-Fi和充電插座。

sentences.en: The underground passage connecting platforms one and two, which was recently renovated with better lighting, is much safer and more convenient than the overpass.
sentences.zh: 連接一號和二號月台的地下通道最近翻新了照明設備，比天橋更安全也更方便。

sentences.en: In order to avoid the morning rush when trains are extremely packed, I usually take the earlier departure that leaves at six forty-five.
sentences.zh: 為了避開列車極度擁擠的早高峰，我通常搭六點四十五分出發的較早班次。

sentences.en: The real-time arrival board, which is displayed on screens throughout the station, indicates that our train is currently running five minutes behind schedule.
sentences.zh: 車站各處螢幕上顯示的即時到站看板指出，我們的列車目前晚了五分鐘。

sentences.en: After tapping your card at the turnstile, make sure you keep it accessible because you will need to tap again when exiting at your destination.
sentences.zh: 在閘門感應卡片後，請確保卡片放在方便拿取的地方，因為到達目的地出站時還需要再感應一次。

sentences.en: The conductor announced over the intercom that passengers holding reserved seat tickets should proceed to carriages five through eight at the front of the train.
sentences.zh: 車掌透過廣播宣布，持有對號座車票的旅客請前往列車前方的第五到第八節車廂。

sentences.en: Given that the bus route was recently modified to include three additional stops in the newly developed residential area, the total journey time has increased by ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 鑒於公車路線最近修改增加了新開發住宅區的三個站，總行車時間增加了十分鐘。
